title: OpportunityRoutingResult
description: Structured output schema for a single scored/routed opportunity record.

company.description: Company name as listed in the source record.

fit_score.description: Composite fit score from the deterministic scoring engine before any LLM rationale pass.

priority_tier.description: 1 = highest priority per the targeting rules (function match, target level, fresh posting); 5 = reach/backfill only.

baseline_recommendation.description: Which resume baseline this role routes to.

knockout_flags.description: Hard blockers surfaced by the rules engine (years-of-experience mismatch, credential requirement, location lock, industry lock). Empty array if none visible.

rationale.description: One-sentence, LLM-generated fit rationale constrained to the system prompt's persona and tone rules.
